reden: Yes. The audit explicitly reports that Guard._checkTransaction/checkTransaction does not block setFallbackHandler(address), allowing a renter to set the Safe’s fallback handler to the rented NFT contract and then call transferFrom/safeTransferFrom via the Safe, which forwards through the fallback with msg.sender == the Safe and bypasses all guard checks. The attack path, impact, code location (Guard and setFallbackHandler), and fix (block/validate setFallbackHandler) match the described vulnerability exactly for ERC721/1155 theft.
